briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Gemini 3.5 push AGI timeline forward amid escalating compute race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases while governments debate export controls. Funding remains robust with major rounds in infrastructure and safety tooling.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4-preview with 2.1T parameters; Google releases Gemini 3.5 Flash; xAI deploys Grok-3; Meta open-sources Llama 4 405B variant.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and BCI deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reaches 500k units monthly; Microsoft and CoreWeave announce $4B Texas data center expansion.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will regulatory fragmentation slow US labs more than Chinese counterparts by 2027?
